QuestInfo.name: [Party Quest] Dimensional Schism
QuestInfo.0:
There's a Dimensional Crack at #b#m220000000##k! We need courageous explorers to stem the tide of otherworldly monsters. Any willing explorers may use the #bDimensional Mirror#k to travel to the Crack.


1st Step: Eliminate all Ratz and Black Ratz.

2nd Step: Eliminate all monsters behind the door.

3rd Step: Enter the hidden portal on top of the box.

4th Step: Eliminate Rombot.

5th Step: Solve the quiz.

6th Step: Eliminate Alishar.
